pr_title: EQL: Add ? support (match single char) to wildcard functionality in  `:` operator
pr_body:
Introduce support for ? character to wildcard pattern to : operator and
by transition, to wildcard function.

Fix #65536

issue_context.title: EQL: Add ? support (match single char) to wildcard functionality in  `:` operator
issue_context.body: Wildcard pattern supported by `:` currently checks only for `*` but `?` should be supported as well.

review_comments: Not strictly related to the change, but was wondering the value choice for the escape character (in `StringUtils#toLikePattern()`). Would `\0` have collided with anything?
0 ignores escaping, that is no character acts as an escape.
